title: It was supposed to be a pig.
description:
It was supposed to be a pig. On 20 August 2009, Markus 'Notch' Persson swapped the length and height while modelling a pig for the new game, and got a tall, narrow shape instead.

Wrote in an IRC log at 12:10: 'omg I think I failed at making a pig, haha'. Seven minutes later: 'haha, I'll keep it for a creepy creature.'

and taught it to explode. The creeper entered the actual game twelve days later, in the pre-alpha build 0.24_SURVIVAL_TEST on 1 September 2009.

Minecraft's most famous monster started life as a pig that went wrong.

Sources:
- https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Creeper_(Minecraft): confirms the 20 August 2009 accidental origin while Markus Persson was modelling a pig, the swapped length and height dimensions, his decision to keep the shape and give it a green leaf-texture skin, and the 1 September 2009 pre-alpha release in build 0.24_SURVIVAL_TEST.
- https://archive.org/download/Minecraft_IRC_Logs_2009/DBN-IRC-Logs/#minecraft.20090820.log: the original 20 August 2009 IRC log, quoted directly, timestamped 12:10:38 and 12:17:33.
- https://www.ign.com/articles/minecraft-probably-wouldnt-add-creepers-today-as-theyd-be-too-controversial-but-dont-worry-theyre-not-going-anywhere-now-theyre-so-iconic: October 2025 interview in which lead designer Jens Bergensten says creepers would likely not be added under Minecraft's current design principles, while confirming there are no plans to remove them.
